## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Konstanz, Germany. It starts at Hafenstraße 9.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Right by the water of Lake Constance, SEA LIFE Konstanz is a wonderful water kingdom just waiting to be explored.
>
> Dive right into a cerulean world of marine life and learn fascinating facts about the creatures who call this lakeside aquarium home. Meet gentle Gentoo penguins and radical sea turtles. Wander through an eight-meter-long tunnel under the Red Sea exhibit, and even follow the exploits of two virtual Belugas with a 360° video trip to their Iceland home. There are even toothy piranhas!

On 13 November 2026, WeGoTrip's product data listed it from €25.88. It was rated 4.3 out of 5 from 297 ratings and 99 written reviews. The final price is shown at WeGoTrip's checkout.
